# Collect the 2 current green blocks, then do ACTION7 5 more times to get all 7
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
green_blocks = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']

# Get click positions for current green blocks

for gb in green_blocks:
    boundary = gb['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]

    center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2

# Now do ACTION7 5 more times to get all 7 blocks

    result = action(['ACTION7'])
    seg3 = current_frame.segmentation
    green3 = [n for n in seg3['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
